title: Just ok
text: Just ok. Have tried a ton of travel pillows.  This one is nice but still no neck support and I still get a head ache.  My husband likes it

product_metadata.title: VISCO LOVE ProComf Travel and Camping Mate/Baby/Kid's/Teen's/Adult's Memory Foam Pillow (White)
features: ❃PERFECT TRAVEL CUSHIONS: Enjoy a restful and quiet sleep wherever you go – traveling by car, plane, or train, taking a power nap in the office, or lounging on the couch. With our viscoelastic Volar pillow, you'll never miss the comfort of your home.

❃LIGHTWEIGHT & PORTABLE: The TRAVEL MATE pillow weighs less than half a liter of water and comes with a convenient travel bag. Its compact design makes it easy to carry everywhere. See images for more details.

❃ERGONOMIC & ORTHOPEDIC DESIGN: Developed in collaboration with sleep experts, our Smart Foam pillow offers an exceptional sleeping experience and optimal nighttime recovery. The pillow provides excellent neck and cervical spine support, helping to prevent back and neck pain as well as tension.

❃ADVANCED MOISTURE MANAGEMENT: Our pillow features microcapsules with a special thermic coating and integrated ventilation ducts, ensuring optimal air circulation and temperature control for a healthy sleep microclimate. Experience less sweating and no more shivering during sleep.
